reviews.author: MetalerMetaller
reviews.text:
[Hanyang University Legendary Dessert House]

A dessert restaurant located in Wangsimni in front of Hanyang University for over 10 years...
With the rise of cafes, Wangsimni is one of the few places that survived even as all kinds of restaurants closed and new cafes opened.

-Interior: Even now, 10 years ago, the pink and yellow paint is still the same... There is nothing special about the interior. Still, it's commendable that there's a waiting table next to the store. In 2025, a door and air conditioner will be added to the empty space next door, making it great for waiting or eating even in the summer.
However, the wooden stairs in front of the store seem ugly and dangerous as they were left as is, even though they were all crushed.
As of 2022, deliveries that were previously not provided were also made, and kiosks were introduced. In the past, I have memories of ordering by number, holding something like a hwatu card, and receiving waffles haha.

-Food: You can choose from waffles made with dozens of different ingredients. The boss likes combinations, but there are all kinds of combinations, making it difficult for people who have trouble making choices.
The taste is not amazing, but it is very good value for money.

Even after 10 years, the ding-dong sound still lingers in a store that brings back memories.

reviews.author: RIMI

It was just better than I thought. The whipped cream was vegetable, but it was too greasy. The apple jam wasn't thick, which was disappointing. It seemed like they gave too little apple jam. Instead, the waffles with banana topping were given plenty of bananas.

What is the difference from Waffle University?
The cream and whipped cream feel of Waffle University suits my taste better, but the waffle itself seems to be a little more sticky, the price is a little cheaper, and there are plenty of toppings added.
But I like Waffle University’s apple jam and butter cream.
It was better, but it tasted like a street waffle so I enjoyed it. However, I was more disappointed than I expected haha.

reviews.author: A house that only tastes good
reviews.text:
Yogurt ice cream specialty chain
Located a 4-minute walk from Exit 10 of Wangsimni Station.
Plain single cup is 4,500 won, honeycomb honey is 4,000 won, and granola is 1,500 won.
​
Granola?
Try the combination recommended by my nephew: honeycomb honey + granola topping!
“Was granola always this sweet?” It was surprisingly sweet and had a good texture, so I surprisingly liked it.
I think this is why this was the signature menu.
However, since the honeycomb honey is too sweet, I add it a little at a time.
The sour taste of yogurt ice cream offsets the sweetness well, providing a good balance.
The total price is about 10,000 won, so it feels a bit expensive, but
It's not bad for two people to enjoy casually.
​
Store & Tips & Review
The store is small and has about 3 tables for 2 people.
It's a great atmosphere to come and eat alone.
Ordering and payment are made using a kiosk.
However, perhaps due to age, this kiosk is somewhat difficult.
After ordering, there are times when you feel that the product is slightly different from what you expected. Haha
I've visited other branches as well, and there's definitely a lot of delivery and takeout.
The store is bright and clean, but it leaves a slightly stuffy feeling.
